title: Offensive Torches
description: Ever wanted to to burn enemies with torches? This mod allows you to ignite your foes by either hitting them with torches, or by throwing a torch at them!
body:
Torches now ignite entities on hit, you can also throw torches by shift-right-clicking while holding one. Works great paired with the Enhanced Hordes mod by nojustgavin.
Made with MCreator
